title: Microsoft Purview Communication Compliance: alert frequency and email recipients per policy (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the existing alert control is presented as a navigation path that the cited page does not document. The permissions gap also overlooks Microsoft's published roles for configuring Communication Compliance policies and settings. The roadmap dates, government-cloud scope and existing alert defaults are accurately reported.
